sloka: दनुः नाम दितेः पुत्रः शापात् राक्षसताम् गतः ।आख्यातः तेन सुग्रीवः समर्थो वानराधिपः ॥४-४-१५॥
transliteration: danuḥ nāma diteḥ putraḥ śāpāt rākṣasatām gataḥ ।ākhyātaḥ tena sugrīvaḥ samartho vānarādhipaḥ ॥4-4-15॥

translations.english: 'Diti's son called Danu who had been cursed to live the life of a demon had said that Sugriva, the best among monkeys, would be able to locate her.
